user.title: Helios Tilt site
user.description: Where the panels are and where the wind comes from. Panels are added in the next step.

data_description.latitude: Defaults to your Home Assistant location.
data_description.longitude: Defaults to your Home Assistant location.
data_description.weather_entity: Wind speed, gusts, condition (snow/rain), temperature and cloud cover.
data_description.wind_sensor: Optional local anemometer. The highest of all wind readings is used.

panel.title: First panel

data_description.actuator_entity: A cover (set_cover_position), a number / input_number, or a script (gets angle, position and panel as variables). Only for the entity type.
data_description.axis: Tilt: the panel leans toward the azimuth (0 = flat). Roll: a single-axis tracker; negative angles tilt the other way.
data_description.azimuth: Tilt: the direction the panel faces (180 = south). Roll: the direction of positive tilt (axis + 90).
data_description.min_angle: Soft limit, never commanded below this.
data_description.max_angle: Soft limit, never commanded above this.
data_description.step: Targets are rounded to this step (0 = no rounding).
data_description.strategy: How the angle is chosen in automatic mode.
data_description.actuator_type: An existing entity (cover, number or script), or two relays (open + close) driving a dumb actuator by time.

data_description.open_switch: Switch that makes the actuator extend (Zigbee2MQTT: switch.<name>_l1). The actuator must have its own limit switches.
data_description.close_switch: Switch that makes it retract (switch.<name>_l2). Never both on: Helios switches the other one off first.
data_description.open_countdown: Optional, e.g. number.<name>_countdown_l1. Set for every run as a hardware fail-safe: the relay switches itself off even if Home Assistant stops.
data_description.open_time: Seconds from fully closed to fully open. Measure it with Reconfigure > Time the travel.
data_description.close_time: Seconds from fully open to fully closed (often different).
data_description.angle_closed: Measure the panel (or window) angle at both ends; the stroke is mapped linearly in between, or use a calibration table of angle:stroke% pairs.
data_description.start_delay: Seconds the motor needs before it moves. Usually 0.
data_description.home_overrun: Runs to an end stop keep going this % of the travel time longer, so the estimate re-syncs.
data_description.reverse_delay: Pause after a run before going the other way.
data_description.home_after_moves: Drift builds up with every move; home again after this many moves (0 = only when needed).
data_description.home_at_night: Drive into the home end stop before the night park.

data_description.position_at_min: Swap the two positions to invert the actuator.
data_description.calibration: angle:position pairs, e.g. 0:0, 15:22, 30:47, 45:75, 60:100. Two relays: angle:stroke% (0 = fully closed).
data_description.feedback_entity: Optional. Without it the cover position is used, or an estimate from the travel time.
data_description.travel_time: Seconds from minimum to maximum. Used for estimates and the stuck check.

data_description.stow_angle: Lowest wind load for your mount, usually flat.
data_description.season_weight: Seasonal strategy: 50 is a plain cosine, higher stays at the winter angle longer.

data_description.pv_peak_power: Peak power of the panels on this mount, for the actual-vs-model sensor.

panel.description: One mount driven by one actuator. Add more panels later from the integration page.

data_description.latitude: Defaults to your Home Assistant location.
data_description.longitude: Defaults to your Home Assistant location.
data_description.weather_entity: Wind speed, gusts, condition (snow/rain), temperature and cloud cover.
data_description.wind_sensor: Optional local anemometer. The highest of all wind readings is used.

error.wind_source_required: Choose a weather entity or a wind speed sensor: wind protection needs one.
error.max_below_min: The maximum angle must be above the minimum angle.
error.tilt_range: A tilt axis works between 0 and 90 degrees. Use the roll axis for negative angles.
error.calibration_required: Enter a calibration table or choose linear mapping.
error.invalid_mapping: The mapping can't be used. Table: at least two angle:position pairs, positions rising (or falling) with the angle. Linear: the two positions must differ.
error.actuator_in_use: This actuator already drives another panel.
error.resume_above_stow: The resume speed must be below the stow speed.
error.storm_below_stow: The storm speed must be at least the stow speed.
error.actuator_required: Choose the actuator entity, or pick the two relays type.
error.relays_required: Choose both the open and the close relay (in the Two relays section).
error.same_relay: The open and close relay must be different switches.
error.same_countdown: The two countdowns must be different entities.
error.same_end_angles: The angles at fully closed and fully open must differ.
error.limits_outside_stroke: The minimum and maximum angle must lie between the angles at fully closed and fully open.
error.still_homing: Still closing. Wait until it has closed fully and starts to open, then submit when it reaches the open end.
error.calibration_failed: The calibration stopped (a relay did not respond, or it took too long). Both relays are off.

abort.already_configured: This site is already set up.

travel.title: Time the travel: {panel}
travel.description: Keep the actuator in sight and stay clear of it. On submit it first closes fully (homing) for the time below, then starts opening. On the next screen, submit the moment it reaches the fully open end.

data_description.homing_seconds: Long enough to close fully from anywhere, plus a margin.

travel_open.title: Opening...
travel_open.description: It closes first, then opens. Submit the moment it stops at the fully open end.

travel_close.title: Closing...
travel_close.description: Now it closes. Submit the moment it stops at the fully closed end.

travel_result.title: Measured travel
travel_result.description: Check the measured times and enter the panel angle at both ends.

init.title: Safety and timing
init.description: Wind speeds are in km/h whatever unit your sensors report. Priority is always safety, then manual, then automatic.

data_description.storm_hold_hours: Storm mode stays on this long after the last strong wind. 0 = until you resume by hand.
data_description.stale_minutes: Without fresh wind data panels freeze (or stay stowed if it was windy).
data_description.cloud_threshold: Tracking strategy only: above this cloud cover the panel goes to the diffuse angle.
data_description.hysteresis: Extra margin before a rounded target changes step.

set_tilt.name: Set tilt
set_tilt.description: Move panels to an angle and switch them to manual mode.

angle.name: Angle
angle.description: Panel angle in degrees (clamped to the soft limits).

stow.name: Stow
stow.description: Move panels to their stow angle and keep them there until resumed.

storm.name: Storm mode
storm.description: Also latch storm mode for the whole site.

resume_auto.name: Resume automatic
resume_auto.description: Clear stow, manual mode, the manual pause and storm mode.

set_mode.name: Set mode
set_mode.description: Automatic, manual, or force a strategy.

calibrate.name: Calibrate
calibrate.description: Tell Helios the panel's real angle (for actuators without feedback).

home.name: Home now
home.description: Panels on two relays: drive into the home end stop to re-sync the estimate, then back to the target.

calibrate_travel.name: Time the travel
calibrate_travel.description: Panels on two relays: start closes fully, then opens; call stop when it reaches the open end, and again at the closed end. The times are saved.

homing_seconds.name: Homing time
homing_seconds.description: How long to close first. Default: the maximum run time.

not_a_panel.message: {target} is not a Helios Tilt panel.

not_relays.message: Choose a panel driven by two relays.

actuator_stuck.title: {panel}: actuator did not reach its angle
actuator_stuck.description: {entity} was told to go to {target}° but reports {current}°. Check the actuator, its power and its end stops. The warning clears by itself once the panel reaches its target.

relay_fault.title: {panel}: relay problem
relay_fault.description: {fault}. Both relays were switched off and the position is marked uncertain; the next move homes first. Check the relay device, its Zigbee link and the wiring. This clears after the next successful move.
